entries: **A Catppuccin panel theme.** Same blueprint layout (drafting grid, ruler-tick progress bars, drafting-paper corner marks) recolored with the official [Catppuccin](https://github.com/catppuccin/catppuccin) palette — Latte, Frappé, Macchiato, and Mocha, switchable from four swatches at the bottom of the panel. The choice is saved to preferences (not `localStorage`, which WebKit blocks under the panel's null-origin load) and applies on both macOS and the Windows tray.
